description: One CAS number can be claimed by several names in one source list, and keying identity on the number alone fuses substances the list's own characterisation factors keep apart. #34 recorded 41 such fusions in EF 3.1; the rulings in `data/contested-cas-decisions.json` separate the groups whose factors disagree. These expectations hold the result in place, because the failure is silent: nothing about a fused flow object looks wrong from the outside.

expectations.title: CAS 382-34-3 carries four separate substances, not one
expectations.comment: HFE-356mec3, HFE-356pcc3, HFE-356pcf2 and HFE-356pcf3 -- four hydrofluoroethers sharing a registry number, with four different global warming potentials. Four is the count in the 2026-08-14 build and the count the ruling intends: fewer means two of them have been fused again, more means one has been split by something other than the ruling.

expectations.title: Each of the four is published with flows of its own
expectations.comment: Separating the identities is only half the job; a substance nothing resolves to is separated out of the published list rather than into it.
